Changes in gsasl:

- CVE-2026-48829: DIGEST-MD5: Fix NULL pointer dereference in parser (bsc#1266371)

notes.text: In GNU SASL before 2.2.3, DIGEST-MD5 has a NULL pointer dereference affecting both clients and servers, via a known token with no accompanying = character. This occurs in lib/digest-md5/getsubopt.c.
